compiled_state.title: Write unit tests for design-md-lint.sh covering config gate, diff scoping, and hook integration
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-6: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Implementation
Create tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh using tests/lib/assert.sh. Test cases:
1. Config gate never — script exits 0 without invoking lint
2. Config gate always — script proceeds to lint
3. Config gate auto with UI files staged — lint runs
4. Config gate auto without UI files — exits 0 (no-op)
5. Diff scoping — violations on untouched lines ignored (exit 0)
6. Diff scoping — violations on diff-touched lines cause exit non-zero
7. No staged files — exits 0
8. Hook wrapper delegates correctly and propagates exit code
9. Negative directive present in all design-notes.md read sites
10. npx absent — exits 0 (short-circuit)
11. DESIGN.md absent — exits 0 (short-circuit)

Tests use temp git repos to simulate staged file scenarios. Mock npx output.
Use assert.sh pattern: silent on success, FAIL: on failure, print_summary at end.

chmod +x the test file immediately after creation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Test file contains at least 9 test functions
  Verify: grep -c 'test_' tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 9)}'
- [ ] Test suite passes end to end
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
